name: Corner shop with apartment
description: Brick-and-stone corner shop (epicerie), 11 x 9.2 m: brick walls with dressed-stone quoins, string course and cornice under a slate hip roof; a ground-floor shop with display windows, a painted fascia and canvas awnings on the street front and a side door on the corner, the shopkeeper's apartment above with shuttered windows. Two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
